full_judgment: 3. The defendant Nos. 1 and 4 contested the suit by filing two separate sets of written statements denying all the materials allegations contending, inter alia, that the Government took over possession of the suit land in Resumption Case No. 138 of 1965 and thereafter settled the same to Badrul Hossain, the defendant No. 4 and Suruj Ali. They have been possessing the suit land. The defendant No. 4 in his written statement contended that the suit land is the khas land of the Government and the Government settled the same to him by registering bilateral lease deed. He paid consideration and has been possessing the same. Earlier the plaintiff No. 4 filed an application addressing the then Sub-divisional Officer, Sylhet for getting lease of the suit land which was rejected on 21-8-68. Mona Ullah predecessor-in-interest of the plaintiff Nos. 2-4 and Lunee Bibi (petitioner No. la), wife of plaintiff No. 1 Instituted Title Suit No. 12 of 1969, This defendant No. 4 appeared in the said suit and filed written statement. The said suit was dis-missed for default on 21.3.73. The plaintiffs have no title and possession in the suit land. So the suit should be dismissed.
